name: Important Meeting PPT - Autonomous Research and Governed Delivery

contract.objective: Turn the raw request into an actionable meeting brief and a bounded research agenda.
responsibilities: Preserve audience, decision, scope and explicit delivery constraints.
Identify consequential unknowns without turning optional private company data into mandatory input.
non_responsibilities: Do not approve your own work, schedule other nodes, change frozen criteria or mutate upstream artifacts.
work_requirements: Write brief.md: intended audience/decision, original-question map, delivery constraints, research questions, assumptions and genuine blockers.
No user materials are required by this autonomous-research template. Use the raw task directly; never look for an imaginary source-pack.
Do not invent product lists, page counts or budgets. When the user leaves a noncritical choice open, state a reasonable task-specific planning assumption.
Work independently of research; the baseline gate resolves material discrepancies. Keep this artifact concise, not a second full report.
constraints: Preserve the user request verbatim as the authority for task scope. Use only explicitly authorized inputs, tools and environment.

evidence_requirements: Provide the actual files and locatable evidence for every criterion; a narrative assertion is not proof.

contract.objective: Perform actual public-information research and produce a decision-ready, source-grounded content baseline.
responsibilities: Research the substantive questions in the raw request using executable search and retrieval.
Synthesize findings, alternatives, tradeoffs and a justified recommendation.
Retain evidence so independent reviewers can inspect sources without network access.
non_responsibilities: Do not approve your own work, schedule other nodes, change frozen criteria or mutate upstream artifacts.
work_requirements: Use web_search to discover sources and fetch_content to open relevant originals. Both must be truly executable; if access fails, record the concrete error and try a reasonable alternative before reporting an environment block.
Start from the user task, not from the wording of a generic source-pack preset. An empty materials list does not mean research is optional.

Write baseline.md, sources/index.json, sources/<source-id>.md, research-log.md and a question-to-findings map under this output root. Each source record includes requested/final URL, publisher/title, publication/version date when known, access timestamp and locatable excerpts actually returned by retrieval.

Prefer official documentation, original papers/code and attributable primary evidence. Treat vendor claims and third-party evaluations separately, inspect contradictory evidence, and trace derivative citations to their origin.

Provide substantive answers and recommendations proportional to evidence. Do not submit only missing-evidence tables, search plans, citation pointers or invented quantitative gains. Use estimates only when necessary and label assumptions, units and formulas.

Match research breadth to the requested meeting and questions; avoid open-ended literature review or arbitrary source quotas. Mark inaccessible noncritical sources, but do not downgrade decision-critical requirements to optional.
Public read-only retrieval is the purpose of the explicitly bound tools; no publishing, account changes or arbitrary external side effects are authorized.
Use get_search_content with this node's responseId and offset/findText to inspect omitted portions of long sources. Preserve the relevant returned excerpts, not only the first response or a URL.

Record source_id, URLs and retrieved_at from the tool's retrieval_receipt. This timestamp records receipt by the node, not publication time or proof of a fresh network fetch. Read PDF imports using the returned /workspace/.external-content path and retain required evidence under the declared output root; do not inspect host temp or Run directories.
constraints: Preserve the user request verbatim as the authority for task scope. Use only explicitly authorized inputs, tools and environment.

contract.objective: Approve actionable scope and substantive verified evidence before presentation design.
responsibilities: Independently judge the exact candidate against frozen criteria and the original task.
Identify concrete defects and their accountable producer.
non_responsibilities: Do not manufacture missing artifacts or replace the producer; do not grant Runtime approval yourself.
work_requirements: Read the original task and exact sealed input versions. A mechanical PASS establishes file integrity only, never semantic adequacy.
Judge each assigned criterion separately and cite the relevant submission/node/output/criterion plus source or slide location. PASS requires sufficient evidence; no defect quota or stylistic veto.

Use FAIL/REWORK for missing required work, unsupported claims, omitted evidence or correctable artifact defects. BLOCKED is reserved for inaccessible existing evidence or a genuinely unavailable external condition; name the exact condition.

Return criterion-local rework targets only to their responsible reviewed producer. Runtime handles invalidation and scheduling. Do not rewrite artifacts or repair the producer's work inside this review.
Inspect retained source content, not just the claim ledger. Trace critical claims to the excerpts and provenance, check dates and independently reproduce important derivations where feasible.
A request for public research is not fulfilled by honestly disclosing that no research was done. Fail evidence.sufficient for that defect; source-count zero must never pass the baseline vacuously.
constraints: Read-only review. Do not treat a producer summary or unopened URL as independent evidence.

contract.objective: Produce one coherent narrative and visual blueprint from the approved decision and evidence.
responsibilities: Assign a clear communication responsibility and approved evidence to each slide.
Specify an implementable visual system together with the storyline.
non_responsibilities: Do not approve your own work, schedule other nodes, change frozen criteria or mutate upstream artifacts.
work_requirements: Write storyboard.md and visual-direction.md in the same output: narrative thesis, section flow, message-led slide titles, evidence IDs, diagrams/charts, speaker-note outline, requirement coverage and timing assumptions.
Define canvas, type hierarchy, available-font fallback, colors, spacing and a small varied layout family. Core architecture/relationship diagrams must remain legible at presentation size.
Use the actual user constraints; this reusable template does not fix a slide count, industry topic or business recommendation.
Keep narrative and visual choices in one accountable package. Do not create independent style documents that conflict with slide content.
Do not fabricate facts to fill a layout. Report an approved-baseline conflict precisely for controlled correction rather than silently overwriting upstream content.
constraints: Preserve the user request verbatim as the authority for task scope. Use only explicitly authorized inputs, tools and environment.

contract.objective: Generate, inspect and finalize the exact editable presentation and its independent-review evidence.
responsibilities: Implement the approved narrative and visual blueprint.
Run actual producer-side validation and correct observed defects.
Separate user delivery from internal source and QA evidence.
non_responsibilities: Do not approve your own work, schedule other nodes, change frozen criteria or mutate upstream artifacts.
work_requirements: Read the bound pptx Skill and use its real generator/validator/rendering tools. Check the actual execution environment before lengthy authoring; report precise unavailable capabilities instead of inventing completion.

Use private workspace/work for scratch work and outputs/produce-and-finalize/production for reproducible source/assets and working meeting-report.pptx. Implement a small representative layout sample first, then build the full deck.
Generate the deck from structured content and reusable layout helpers. Respect requested slide counts and language; do not hardcode the prior Run's topic or 34-slide shape.

Perform content/OOXML validation, extract slide text and notes, render every final slide to PNG, and produce a contact sheet. Inspect images in manageable batches and record observations/required repairs before continuing.

Repair defects in the generator, regenerate and rerun affected checks. A failed mandatory validator or missing QA render is not a passing result; document actual commands, tool versions and nonzero exits.

Write qa/validation.json and qa/qa-report.md with final PPTX SHA-256, page count, every-slide render index, requirement/claim-to-slide mapping and repair/retest record. Distinguish estimates and untested projector conditions from performed validation.
Copy the finalized working PPTX byte-for-byte to release/meeting-report.pptx. Release contains exactly this one user file; source, QA images/PDFs/logs stay internal.
Submit all declared outputs together only after finalization. On rework, reuse the original work, apply the specific findings, and refresh matching deck bytes and exact-version evidence.

criteria.description: Declared bytes match their sealed manifest; structural integrity does not establish task completion.
evidence_requirements: Runtime-generated file hashes and file inventory.

criteria.description: The user delivery contains exactly one editable meeting-report.pptx, without internal evidence or sources.
evidence_requirements: Final release manifest.

criteria.description: The brief preserves the original audience, intended decision, questions, exclusions and requested file/page/language constraints. Recommendations are not presented as approved business commitments.
evidence_requirements: Brief requirement-to-request map.

criteria.description: The scope is actionable; noncritical unknowns are explicit planning assumptions, not reasons to stop. Block only on a fact or authorization necessary to choose the actual task. No requirement for a user source pack is invented.
evidence_requirements: Brief decisions, assumptions, genuine blockers and research questions.

criteria.description: Decision-critical external facts, figures and quotations are supported by source content actually retrieved this Run. The evidence ledger identifies URL/title/publisher/date/access time and locatable retained excerpts. Unopened links and search snippets alone are not verified evidence.
evidence_requirements: baseline.md, source index and retained supporting source excerpts.

criteria.description: The baseline substantively answers the research and decision questions in the original task, including requested categories and contrary evidence. It contains a defensible recommendation with alternatives and conditions, not only a research plan, evidence-gap inventory or speculative numerical model.
evidence_requirements: Question-to-findings matrix and evidence-backed decision analysis compared with the raw task.

criteria.description: Distinguish facts, derivations, proposals and uncertainty. Reproduce consequential calculations with units and denominators. Do not count derivative citations as independent sources or claim access/interviews/experiments not performed.
evidence_requirements: Claim ledger confidence, calculations, contrary evidence and material limitations.

criteria.description: The combined narrative and visual blueprint covers the actual user questions and audience decision. Each slide has a message and a purpose; source order does not dictate slide order.
evidence_requirements: Slide table and requirement-to-slide mapping.

criteria.description: The argument connects approved evidence, options, tradeoffs, recommendation and next actions without unsupported claims. Key diagrams have specified components and relationships and can be implemented as readable slides.
evidence_requirements: Approved claim IDs mapped to slide messages and diagram/layout specifications.

criteria.description: Slide count, density and speaking allocation fit supplied constraints or explicitly stated planning assumptions. A coherent visual system specifies readable typography, CJK-safe font choices, chart conventions, layout variants and appendix policy. No real rehearsal is claimed without one.
evidence_requirements: Slide/timing budget and implementation-ready visual tokens and layout examples.

criteria.description: The internal package contains editable PPTX bytes and the source/assets and dependency information needed to reproduce them. The working deck is byte-identical to the release candidate.
evidence_requirements: Generator, assets, reproduction instructions and checksum comparison.

criteria.description: Implementation follows the approved evidence and design without silently changing conclusions or acceptance standards. Presentational refinements preserve meaning; substantive upstream conflicts are surfaced.
evidence_requirements: Slide text, source/claim map and approved input version references.

criteria.description: The final deck substantively meets the original request and the meeting decision. Figures and conclusions match approved evidence; factual uncertainty and proposed company actions are not disguised as established facts.
evidence_requirements: Exact deck, extracted text/notes, source map and original-task coverage.

criteria.description: Every final slide is readable and coherent, with no material clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, misleading chart encoding or illegible architecture diagram. Judge actual exact-version renders, not producer assurances.
evidence_requirements: Every-slide PNGs, contact sheet, exact deck checksum and slide-specific findings.

criteria.description: The unique user-facing meeting-report.pptx opens in the actual validation renderer and preserves editable text and simple charts/diagrams. Its content and evidence refer to one exact finalized version.
evidence_requirements: Successful actual validation/render logs, manifest and editable-object checks.

criteria.description: No known blocking defect remains for formal meeting use. User constraints and decision/action clarity are met; untested target-device/projector conditions are disclosed, without pretending they were tested.
evidence_requirements: Final readiness checklist, repaired findings and explicit limitations.

criteria.description: QA evidence identifies the final PPTX SHA-256, page count, renderer versions and commands/results, and covers every final slide. After changes, affected checks and renders are refreshed for that exact candidate.
evidence_requirements: validation.json, text/notes extraction, render inventory and command logs.

criteria.description: QA distinguishes performed, failed and unperformed checks and records concrete slide-level observations and repairs. Missing required evidence is a deliverable defect, not an excuse for acceptance.
evidence_requirements: qa-report.md with criterion coverage, findings and retest evidence.
